title: Finite-coefficient specialization of normalized exceptional base-change mates
statement: For a Cartesian square of schemes, finite commutative coefficient ring, compactifiable vertical maps and quasi-compact primed vertical map, let W and W prime be coefficients identified by pullback. Let gamma and gamma prime be everywhere invertible integration-normalized natural transformations from twisted ordinary pullback to the Brown exceptional pullbacks. If their scalar integration traces satisfy compact-support base change under the coefficient comparison, then the actual exceptional base-change map is invertible on every input K and commutes with gamma and gamma prime through the canonical tensor-pullback and square comparisons. The source associator may be supplied as a family of isomorphisms with a heterogeneous equality to the displayed canonical comparison.

source.place: paragraph 2: projection exchange, tensor compatibility and transposition

proof.text: At finite coefficients the projection transformation and compact-support exchange are invertible. Build the exchange isomorphism with the actual compact-support map as its hom. Supply its published raw projection-exchange equation to the completed generic normalization calculus.

The exceptional exchange is defined to be the mate of inverse compact-support exchange. The inverse derived pullback-square comparison is purityPullbackSquare by definition. Thus the resulting generic equality and invertibility are precisely the claimed finite-coefficient conclusion. Keeping the schemes abstract separates this conversion from substituting vector-bundle constructions.

theorem finiteIntegrationNormalized_baseChange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X X' Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification f'] [QuasiCompact f']
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (W : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A X) (W' : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A X')
    (l : (RfPullback A g').obj W ≅ W')
    (t : (RfShriek A f).obj W ⟶ 𝟙_ _) (t' : (RfShriek A f').obj W' ⟶ 𝟙_ _)
    (a : ∀ K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A Y,
      (RfPullback A g').obj (W ⊗ (RfPullback A f).obj K) ≅
        W' ⊗ (RfPullback A f').obj ((RfPullback A g).obj K))
    (ha : ∀ K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A Y,
      HEq ((Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso (ModuleCat A) g' W
        ((RfPullback A f).obj K) ≪≫ (l ⊗ᵢ purityPullbackSquare A sq K)).hom)
        (a K).hom)
    (γ : RfPullback A f ⋙ tensorLeft W ⟶ RfUpper A f)
    (γ' : RfPullback A f' ⋙ tensorLeft W' ⟶ RfUpper A f')
    (hn : IntegrationGammaNormalized (RfShriek A f) (RfUpper A f) (RfPullback A f)
      (Etale.rightDerivedUpperShriekAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f)
      W t ((Etale.projectionMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app W) γ)
    (hn' : IntegrationGammaNormalized (RfShriek A f') (RfUpper A f') (RfPullback A f')
      (Etale.rightDerivedUpperShriekAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f')
      W' t' ((Etale.projectionMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f').app W') γ')
    (hi : ∀ K, IsIso (γ.app K)) (hi' : ∀ K, IsIso (γ'.app K))
    (ht : (Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A sq).app W ≫
      (RfShriek A f').map l.hom ≫ t' =
      (RfPullback A g).map t ≫ (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso (ModuleCat A) g).hom)
    (K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A Y) :
    IsIso ((Etale.rightDerivedUpperShriekBaseChangeMap A sq).app K) ∧
      (RfPullback A g').map (γ.app K) ≫
        (Etale.rightDerivedUpperShriekBaseChangeMap A sq).app K =
      (a K).hom ≫ γ'.app ((RfPullback A g).obj K)
